<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Consulta de Disponibilidade">eff4514b83e7cf503d22a8d0deaad358</macroponent><name>Identificar Salas Ocupadas</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {

    console.log('===== VERIFICANDO DISPONIBILIDADE =====');

    const reservas =
        api.data.look_up_multiple_records_reservas.results || [];

    const dataSelecionada = api.state.selected_date;
    const horarioSelecionado = api.state.selected_time;

    console.log('Data selecionada:', dataSelecionada);
    console.log('Horário selecionado:', horarioSelecionado);
    console.log('Quantidade de reservas:', reservas.length);

    const salasOcupadas = [];

    function horaParaMinutos(hora) {

        if (!hora) {
            return null;
        }

        const partes = hora.substring(0, 5).split(':');

        return (
            Number(partes[0]) * 60 +
            Number(partes[1])
        );
    }

    const horarioConsulta =
        horaParaMinutos(horarioSelecionado);

    reservas.forEach(function(reserva, index) {

        const sala =
            reserva.sala &&
            reserva.sala.value;

        const data =
            reserva.data &&
            (reserva.data.displayValue || reserva.data.value);

        const horaInicial =
            reserva.hora_inicial &&
            reserva.hora_inicial.displayValue;

        const horaFinal =
            reserva.hora_final &&
            reserva.hora_final.displayValue;

        console.log(
            'Reserva ' + index,
            '| Sala:', sala,
            '| Data:', data,
            '| Início:', horaInicial,
            '| Fim:', horaFinal
        );

        const inicio =
            horaParaMinutos(horaInicial);

        const fim =
            horaParaMinutos(horaFinal);

        const mesmaData =
            data === dataSelecionada;

        const horarioOcupado =
            horarioConsulta !== null &&
            inicio !== null &&
            fim !== null &&
            horarioConsulta >= inicio &&
            horarioConsulta < fim;

        if (
            sala &&
            mesmaData &&
            horarioOcupado
        ) {

            salasOcupadas.push(sala);

            console.log(
                ']]>🔴<![CDATA[ SALA OCUPADA:',
                reserva.sala.displayValue,
                '| horário:',
                horaInicial,
                'até',
                horaFinal
            );
        }
    });

        // Guarda as salas ocupadas no Client State
    api.setState(
        'unavailable_rooms',
        salasOcupadas
    );

    // Atualiza o filtro das salas
    let roomFilter = api.state.room_filter || '';

    // Remove uma eventual regra NOT IN anterior
    roomFilter = roomFilter.replace(
        /\^sys_idNOT IN[^]*/,
        ''
    );

    // Exclui as salas ocupadas
    if (salasOcupadas.length > 0) {

        roomFilter +=
            '^sys_idNOT IN' +
            salasOcupadas.join(',');

    }

    console.log(
        '===== NOVO ROOM FILTER ====='
    );

    console.log(roomFilter);

    api.setState(
        'room_filter',
        roomFilter
    );
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-06 19:31:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>b9efe309837b03d03d22a8d0deaad3fd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Identificar Salas Ocupadas</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Gestao de Espacos" source="x_1026684_gestao_0">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Gestao de Espacos">c869e29a83638b503d22a8d0deaad38c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_b9efe309837b03d03d22a8d0deaad3fd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-06 23:55:16</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
